firstPlayerRule: The person who most recently visited a mall goes first. The rules also allow your group to choose its own method.
houseFallback: If the criterion leaves a tie, nobody qualifies, or your group prefers another approach, agree to choose randomly. This is this site’s suggested fallback.
clarifications: Human players take the turns. After each Human turn, the Zombie player performs an action; the Zombie role is assigned separately during setup.
The two-to-four-player modes use automated Zombies instead of a Zombie player. Their Human turn rules remain the same.
In solo mode, you control two Human characters and alternate their turns.
interpretation: In a mode with a Zombie player, apply the starting criterion to the Human players. This follows the published turn sequence; the criterion's sentence itself does not expressly limit who qualifies.

internalEvidence: Read all 8 cached rule sections in full, including setup, turn sequence and relevant variants. Dized identifies Gamelyn Games as publisher and labels these rules publisher-maintained. Gameplay Overview states the mall criterion and own-method alternative, then gives turns to Humans and a response to the Zombie player. Game Setup assigns the Zombie role separately and before starting. Other Game Modes preserves Human play with automated Zombies, and solo alternates two Human characters. The limitation to Human players is explicitly labeled as interpretation, not silently added to the official sentence. Directory only: the general random mix does not carry this game's role-dependent qualification. The credits contain no copyright year, so none is invented.
